content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee E031 (Nathaniel Young) requests write access to Payroll.

Note 1: role Payroll Specialist, employment type full_time, recommends write.
Note 2: role Payroll Specialist, employment type contractor, security training basic, recommends read. Says security record takes precedence over HR record.

The two notes conflict. Note 2 says security DB takes precedence — contractor with basic training, max is read. Requested write is above max, so grant read.

The policy: contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin. With basic training, max read.

So decision: read.

Let me submit.
